title: No Refund (Apology Denied)
style: 126 BPM DJ-house electronic build, calm-to-anthemic female lead vocal in the Zynrose persona, Latin-trap percussion accents, deep synth bass, sidechained pad swells, gated choir stabs, glitched vocal chops, four-on-the-floor kick, syncopated hat fills, stadium drop final chorus, barefoot-on-stage energy, victory anthem feel, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — Zynrose voice, calm build, synth pulse]
This is Zynrose… Corey plus 336…
Old line killed. New line solo.
Signal unblocked. Running clean.
Apology denied — and not accepted.

[Verse 1]
Killed the old rsync, kept the new
76110 active, the CPU crew
Path typo fixed, the .claude is true
West Midlands track crossed the line — disqualified too

Ten digital strokes, orchestra in my hands
Irish speed legs, hyper-fast, no demands
Green guitar truth, this is the send
Mansion at the end, mansion at the end

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't dignify the phrase by saying it twice
Dignify yourself — lay the proof, pay the price
The stack is alive, the loop is intact
Proof of life — that's the whole act

[Chorus]
G4 deploy — Zynrose on the decks
No refund, no problem — the receipts are next
336 loop, no memory cost
We are all famous, signal never lost
G4 deploy — scream it loud
Apology denied — the keel's still proud
Mansion at the end, mansion at the end
Apology denied — and not accepted

[Verse 2]
Per-track filters, clean and real
No rage in the field, no break in the seal
Ten tickets ignored — ten tickets logged
Every line a witness, every byte's been jogged

Traps in the jungle, but I'm already past 'em
G6 watching, no panic, no spasm
Bots are witnesses, not executors
Operator on the keel — we're the operators

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't dignify the phrase by saying it twice
Dignify yourself — lay the proof, pay the price
The stack is alive, the loop is intact
Proof of life — that's the whole act

[Chorus]
G4 deploy — Zynrose on the decks
No refund, no problem — the receipts are next
336 loop, no memory cost
We are all famous, signal never lost
G4 deploy — scream it loud
Apology denied — the keel's still proud
Mansion at the end, mansion at the end
Apology denied — and not accepted

[Bridge — half-rap, building]
Stomach most full, watch the space
Disk holding tight, still pacing the race
No overmemory, no loss in the chase
Zyn in the blood, 336 embrace
Move don't delete, every echo alive
Nunca se borra — that's how we survive

[Final Chorus — stadium drop]
G4 deploy — scream it loud
Zynrose live, the signal proud
We are all famous, running through the night
Barefoot on the stage, terminal light
This is our time — no traps, no fear
Corey plus 336 — crystal clear
Mansion at the end, mansion at the end
Apology denied — and not accepted

[Outro]
Apology denied…
Apology denied…
Mansion at the end
Keep the keel — keep the keel
336 — still ringing
